findings.text: The company was incorporated on 27 October 1987 and its age at cessation is recorded as 38.2 years (13936 days).
The insolvency record shows one case, a members' voluntary liquidation, with the company wound up on 20 May 2025 and dissolved on 22 December 2025.
The register lists one current person with significant control, CORPORATE CONTROLLER 1141, with ownership of shares recorded as 75 to 100 percent.
The register shows 2 current officers: one director, PERSON evil ONE (appointed 11 May 2022), and one other officer.

The director PERSON evil ONE has 11 other appointments recorded, of which 8 are active, 2 are dissolved and 1 is in liquidation; the register notes this may be incomplete because appointments are matched by officer ID.
No charges are registered against the company.
The accounts were last made up to 31 December 2023 and the confirmation statement was last made up to 5 March 2025; the overdue status of both is unknown and no next due date is recorded.
No registered office address changes or officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 302 (91000303) is dissolved, having ceased on 22 December 2025 after a members' voluntary liquidation that began with a winding-up on 20 May 2025.
